bio: Filippina Iera was baptized on 6 March 1819 at San Mango D'Aquino in Calabria, the daughter of Rosario Iera and Faustina Ferlaino. She married Raffaele Colosimo there on 24 March 1839 and was John's 4th-great-grandmother. She died in November 1871 and was buried on 10 November of that year.
